name: Safia Lancaster
original_name: サフィア・ランカスター
source:
[u][b]The Clumsy Witch Oppai Spy![/b][/u]
Race: Witch
Code Name: Jewel
Third Year at Espiona Girls' Academy
Assigned Class: Snake Unit
Club: Spy Magic Club

Safia is a third-year student at Espiona Spy Academy, and  a witch. She serves as the overseer of the class known as the Snake Unit, a group that specializes in infiltration and stealth.

She is a powerful magic user capable of wielding numerous high-level spells, and calls herself the “Crimson Genius Witch.” She possesses one of the highest levels of magical power on the continent, and her output is on an entirely different level, truly befitting her claim of being a genius.…However, in reality she cannot properly control her magic, and has repeatedly caused destruction throughout the academy and dorms, making her something of a hopeless witch.
She is called things like “Calamity Witch” and an "open powder keg” by others, though she herself is completely unaware of it.

She is confident and carefree, not one to worry about small details. Simply put, she is a bit of an airhead. She believes she is good at taking care of her underclassmen, but in reality they are the ones taking care of her. The Snake Unit is united in figuring out how to deal with her antics, and as a result, their class has strong cohesion. Safia herself seems to misunderstand this and thinks it is because she is popular. That said, when it comes to magical knowledge, she is the real deal, and she may even have a sharp eye for observation.

She is extremely interested in the protagonist and is determined to recruit him into her class. She believes it will be easy thanks to her charm and her figure, which often results in her getting sexually harassed by him instead.

Her codename is “Jewel,” a reference to how she likens her many spells to shining gemstones.
Her ability as a spy is a transformation spell that allows her to perfectly copy another person.
This type of magic requires immense magical power and constant maintenance, making it something only a select few can use. That is how she became the overseer of the Snake Unit. But it has one major flaw: even if her appearance is perfectly replicated, she is still herself underneath, so she quickly gives herself away when she speaks. She attends remedial classes in acting and performance, but so far her progress has not been very good.

Her boobs are V-cups, with a “genius-level long, semi-elliptical drooping” shape.
They are the largest among the students, and she proudly calls them her “victorious V-cups.”
Her specialty in honey traps involves using magic and magical potions to charm and entice others.

However, she often ends up failing and getting affected by her own techniques instead.

Her hobbies include hair care (which she’s terrible at) and developing new spells (which she fails at). Her special skill is magic in general (which is dangerous).

Her mother, Isolte, is also her mentor as a witch. She is one of the three great witches of the continent, but she seems to have a hard time dealing with her daughter. Even so, their relationship is good, and they often spend time together after school having tea at Isolte’s research cottage on the academy grounds.

•Nipples: 5.3 mm (Height) ~ “If you suck that hard♥ I’ll start leaking milk♥”

•Hips: 90 cm ~ “All the famous witches have big butts!”
•Thighs: 46.5 cm (Thickness) ~ “They’re smooth and soft. In other words, perfect!”
